reinitialization_scheme.all_parameter_reinitialization: copy every trainable parameter from a freshly declared model initialized with the requested seed
reinitialization_scheme.group_parameter_reinitialization: copy only the requested trainable parameter group from a freshly declared model initialized with the requested seed
reinitialization_scheme.logit_scale_scalar: restored to the model-declared math.log(40.0) initialization, not a fallback random scalar
